contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), issue of 318-320, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Helmeted bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories resting shield inscribed VOT / P R on altar. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP. In exergue: TRP, for first officina, Trier mint. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.46mm, Weight: 2.46gms, dis axis: 6
